channel.title: Plain Earnings — new reports
channel.description: New earnings reports explained in plain English, with interactive money-flow charts.

item.title: Moderna — Q3 2026 earnings, explained
item.description: Moderna swung back to a profit on 29% revenue growth, but the profit is thin and the cost cuts did as much work as the sales rebound — and the fat cash balance came from a $3 billion convertible-note raise, not from operations.

item.title: Microsoft — FY27 Q1 earnings, explained
item.description: Microsoft grew 19% to $92.3B on Azure's 48% surge, and customers have now committed $677B of future cloud spending — the AI boom is real, and so is the bill to build it.

item.title: Alphabet — Q3 2026 earnings, explained
item.description: Google's operating profit rose 30% and Cloud more than doubled — but an $8.7B paper loss on its stock holdings turned the bottom line down 24%.

item.title: Amazon — Q3 2026 earnings, explained
item.description: Amazon's operating profit jumped 61% as AWS accelerated to 39% growth — but net income slipped, because last year's quarter included a $9.5B one-off Anthropic gain, and free cash flow went deeply negative on AI data-center spending.

item.title: Meta Platforms — Q3 2026 earnings, explained
item.description: Meta's ads grew 26% to $64.6B, but a $9.9B legal settlement cut operating profit by more than a third — and the number to watch is the $7.40 it would have earned without it.
